text: A detector's system detection efficiency factorizes as eta_SDE = eta_couple * eta_absorb * eta_internal. For a waveguide-integrated SNSPD, which term is solved by traveling-wave evanescent absorption (1 - e^(-alpha*L), ~1 dB/um)?
choices: eta_absorb (the probability the photon is absorbed in the nanowire)
explanation: Running the nanowire along the waveguide lets the mode be absorbed evanescently over its length (1 - e^(-alpha*L)), giving 91-99% on-chip absorption (Pernice 2012); this addresses eta_absorb. Coupling efficiency (choice 0) and internal/hotspot efficiency (choice 1) are separate factors, and dark counts (choice 2) are not part of the SDE product.
